jobs.occupation: Lead Warehouse Associate in 2 Shifts – Grow with a Dynamic Logistics Team
jobs.description:
As a Lead Warehouse Associate in 2 shifts, you'll organize and oversee the order picking process. At the start of your shift, the foreman will brief you on the targets for the day. Together with your team, you ensure the right products are accurately picked and packed, and that all goals are met.

On an average workday, you guide your team in picking orders on the line, monitor quality and efficiency, and adjust where needed. You're the first point of contact for your colleagues, maintain order and cleanliness, and make sure everyone works safely. You'll work in a rotating shift system, which brings plenty of variety and dynamism.

Ready to use your experience as an order picker in a leadership role within an international and financially stable company? Apply today and help build a motivated and strong team!

• Experience as an order picker or in a first-line leadership role

• Motivation and accuracy are more important than your diploma

• Strong attention to detail and quality

• Able to handle stress and perform well in a busy environment

• Strong team spirit but also able to work independently

• Eager to learn and open to discovering more about the production department

• Keep the workplace tidy and prioritize safety

• Fluent in Dutch or English

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as a Customer Service Officer (German-Polish-English): Multicultural Environment
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer (German-Polish-English), you are the first point of contact for customers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. You play a key role in getting stranded vehicles moving again by efficiently coordinating between customers, partners, and workshops. You’ll join a close-knit team where you’ll be supported daily by an experienced team lead and helpful colleagues.
On a typical day, you’ll answer incoming phone calls and emails, gather the necessary information, and check for completeness and accuracy. You’ll liaise with technical partners and workshops, keeping all parties updated on progress. You’ll monitor agreements and ensure all contract-related matters are handled within deadlines. The role runs from Monday to Friday, but you’ll show flexibility to work on Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.
Are you stress-resistant, customer-focused, and looking for a varied role? Apply now and become the go-to contact for our international customers!

You are fluent in German, Polish, and English. Any additional language is a plus.
You hold at least a diploma in higher secondary education, associate degree, or bachelor’s degree.
You have strong Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).
Technical automotive or tire knowledge is an advantage, but not required.
You communicate clearly and professionally over the phone.
You work accurately, remain calm under stress, and can multitask effectively.
You are customer-oriented, solution-focused, and results-driven.
You are willing to work in a shift system between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM and are flexible during busy periods.

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

jobs.occupation: Experienced Wheel Loader Operator Wanted for Recycling Site in Sint-Katelijne-Waver
jobs.description:
For our client, a leading recycling company in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, I am looking for an experienced wheel loader operator. You play a crucial role in keeping the material flow around our fixed crushing installation running smoothly. You actively work with the team and support daily operations wherever needed.

On an average day, you operate the wheel loader to move, sort, and stockpile rubble and recycled aggregates. You supply the crushing installation and assist with loading and unloading trucks. Operating a forklift is also part of your tasks, as well as carrying out daily inspections and basic maintenance of the machines. You promptly report technical issues and ensure the workplace remains safe and tidy, even in dusty conditions.

Does this hands-on, varied position appeal to you? Apply soon – I am happy to tell you more about this great opportunity.

• Valid wheel loader license (required by Belgian regulations)

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a wheel loader operator

• Willingness to operate a forklift (license is a plus)

• Good command of English (spoken and written)

• Able to work independently and reliably

• Hands-on mentality and flexible

• Punctual, communicative, and in good physical condition

• Willing to work in a dusty, outdoor industrial environment

Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

jobs.occupation: Tax Advisor – Employment Tax & Global Mobility at Zaventem (Diegem) | Pro-Pay
jobs.description:
YOUR ROLE AS A TAX ADVISOR
 

As a Tax Advisor, you'll combine tax advisory work with personal income tax compliance for an international client portfolio. You'll advise employers and employees on Belgian and international employment tax matters, working closely with colleagues from our payroll, legal and immigration teams.
 

No two cases are quite the same, and you'll have the opportunity to develop your expertise in the exciting field of employment tax and global mobility.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Advising clients on Belgian employment tax matters, including salary packages, benefits-in-kind, incentive plans and payroll-related tax questions. 

• Supporting international mobility cases, including double tax treaty interpretation, cross-border employment structures, salary split calculations and Belgian Special Tax Regime applications. 

• Preparing Belgian personal income tax returns and tax calculations for internationally mobile employees. 

• Keeping up with tax developments and translating legislative changes into practical advice for clients and colleagues. 

• Working closely with payroll, legal and immigration specialists to provide clients with an integrated service. 

• Contributing your ideas and expertise to the continued growth of our Tax practice. 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 

You might be a great fit if you:
 
 

• Hold a Master's degree in Law, Tax, Economics or a related field. 

• Have a strong interest in international taxation and cross-border employment. 

• Are a recent graduate or already have some relevant experience and are eager to keep developing 
your expertise. 

• Enjoy combining technical tax knowledge with practical, client-oriented advice. 

• Communicate fluently in English (C1-level) and have a good command of Dutch and French. 

• Take ownership, show initiative and have an eye for detail. 

• Enjoy working together, sharing knowledge and being part of a supportive team.

What will you do?
 
 
 
• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system. 
 
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items. 
 
• Rotating tasks, including working in cold storage areas. 
 
• Registering goods correctly in the system. 
 
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment. 
 
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn. 
 
• You are flexible and willing to rotate in all shifts (early, late, and night). 
 
• You can handle working in cold areas. 
 
• You speak and understand English well. 
 
• You have your own means of transportation.

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!
 

A selection of your responsibilities:
 

 
• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
 
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
 
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
 
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
 
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
 
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
 
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
 
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools. 

We are looking for the following profile:
 

 
• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
 
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
 
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
 
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
 
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
 
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
 
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
 
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
 
• You are available for a full-time position.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …),
 

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.
 

As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for 
Repair Operators/Body Shop Painters to strengthen our teams.
 

As a 
Repair Operator/Body Shop Painter, you carry out various tasks related to repairs and adjustments on aircraft engine parts
 
 

• You will review the work documents that contain the necessary elements to perform the tasks (materials, products, technical instructions, references to the reference documents, and procedures); 

• You perform the assigned tasks accurately and respect the planning in order to avoid any negative impact on work organization, scheduling, or complaints from internal customers. 

• You will use the required PPE when performing tasks according to the rules defined by HSE or the usual regulations within SAESB (e.g., risk analysis); 

• You report clearly and precisely on identified issues, difficulties, or risks related to the activity or the product, using the designated reporting tools; 

• You communicate the status of the activity/activities at the end of the shift; 

• You will participate in working groups to analyze problems and improve work processes (continuous improvement, error and defect analysis and correction, internal and external audits, etc.). 

Your profile:

• You hold a secondary education diploma in a technical field.
• You have a good knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts (6am - 2pm or 2pm - 10pm).
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment, and are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
